[[Maul of the Hierophant]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[hammer]] obtained from the [[Hierophant's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Duncan the Black]] in [[Slavers' Exile]].

== Stats ==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] on hit (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Stone Crusher (weapon)|Stone Crusher]], [[dye]]d black.
